text:
I read the bowl as a small cereal-type bowl, about 15 cm across (it measures roughly 190 px in the photo). The bowl holds white pieces that look like soft white chunks, possibly tofu, egg whites, or steamed cassava. They are broad flat slices, so I judged them most likely to be tofu or a similar item. Red chili sauce (sambal) sits on top.

For the white pieces, the bowl's inner area is about 150 cm² and the pile is about 3 cm deep, which gives roughly 200 g. For the sauce, I estimate about 45 g covering the center.

I used 100 kcal per 100 g for tofu and about 40 kcal per 100 g for the sambal.
